supervisor.label: Fleet Support Supervisor
supervisor.blurb: The headline role. Titles read either "Robotaxi Fleet Support Supervisor" or "Supervisor, Robotaxi Fleet Support", same posting text.
points: Leads a team of Robotaxi Fleet Support Specialists so the fleet stays properly maintained and charged and hits daily deadlines.
Owns daily fleet readiness: interior and exterior cleaning, upkeep standards, charging coordination and condition checks.
Moves and positions cars by status (deployment, charging, service, repair) and works the Service/Repair Offline Queue to cut downtime.
Launches and supports AP Drivers, runs safety and quality audits, keeps supplies stocked.
Asks for 3+ years leading teams in a fast-paced ops setting and a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, holidays and on-call. Most are night shift, often 10:00PM to 06:30AM.

specialist.label: Fleet Support Specialist
specialist.blurb: Related role. The crew the supervisors lead.
points: Keeps every robotaxi in excellent condition to support 24/7 operations.
Vehicle prep and inspections, cleaning (car wash and minor detailing), lot management, safely moving and charging cars.
Valid driver's license required, and it's listed as a safety-critical position.

operations.label: Robotaxi Operations
operations.blurb: Related roles: Robotaxi Operations Advisor and Robotaxi Operations Manager.
points: Advisors handle compliance, regulatory and logistics work so the fleet runs smoothly, including DMV registrations and plates.
They also support vehicle activation and daily operations, and help riders get lost items back.
